title: Decomposing Browser Pipeline Architectures for DOM-Sourced Particle Effects: Worker Offload, WebGL, and WebAssembly
abstract: arXiv:2608.23609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local optimization does not necessarily yield end-to-end optimization in layered browser architectures. Teams often treat Web Workers, WebGL, and WebAssembly as interchangeable ways to "make it faster," yet each lever targets a different layer. We present a controlled architectural decomposition--using DOM-sourced particle pipelines as a concrete workload--of five particle pipelines (P1-P5), with an additional non-particle CSS-layer baseline (P0), that isolates thread placement, renderer choice, and simulation backend. translated_title: 分解浏览器管线架构以实现DOM源粒子效果：Worker卸载、WebGL与WebAssembly
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23609v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在分层浏览器架构中，局部优化并不一定能带来端到端的优化。团队常常将Web Workers、WebGL和WebAssembly视为可互换的“加速”手段，然而每种手段针对的是不同的层。我们提出了一种受控的架构分解方法——以DOM源粒子管线作为具体工作负载——对五种粒子管线（P1-P5）进行了研究，并增加了一个非粒子CSS层基线（P0），该方法隔离了线程放置、渲染器选择和模拟后端。通过可复现的测试工具，我们测量了交互节奏、高负载端到端压力以及仅模拟的微基准测试，并在同主机跨浏览器/双GPU类复现（Firefox 153+Intel UHD；Chrome 138+NVIDIA NVK）以及Google Colab上的独立第二主机切片（Chrome 150，Tesla T4，n=5）中进行了验证。四个结果尤为突出。（1）Worker卸载改善了以Chrome为主浏览器的交互节奏（约144 vs 一个...）
tldr: 通过受控分解实验，发现Worker卸载、WebGL和WebAssembly在浏览器管线中分别优化不同层次，且Worker卸载在Chrome上显著提升交互性能，但需结合具体架构选择。
en_tdlr: Through controlled decomposition experiments, Worker offload, WebGL, and WebAssembly optimize different layers in browser pipelines, with Worker offload significantly improving interactive pacing on Chrome, yet requiring architecture-specific choices.
